eventContext: CanalBarra.com archived homepage footer naming Lucas and BarMan as WebMasters
publicDescription: An archived CanalBarra.com homepage footer from the Wayback Machine, supplied for repository review, identifies Lucas and BarMan together as WebMasters and shows a navigation structure with sign-up, users, operators, rules, Brasnet, extranet, advertising and login/registration modification links. participantReference.roleDescription: Lucas is identified by the archived footer as co-Webmaster alongside BarMan and is requested to confirm the technical custody, implementation stack and community features of the CanalBarra.com web layer.
